name: forgecad-runtime
description: Codex-only MCP runtime and 3D viewer for ForgeCAD.

scripts.desktop:tauri-build: script/with_rust_toolchain.sh npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- build --bundles app
scripts.desktop:tauri-package:macos: test -n "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" && script/with_rust_toolchain.sh sh -c 'cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release -p forgecad-runtime --bin forgecad-runtime -p forgecad-mcp --bins --offline && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target cargo build --manifest-path apps/geometry-worker/Cargo.toml --release --bin forgecad-geometry-worker --offline && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target cargo build --manifest-path apps/render-worker/Cargo.toml --release --bin forgecad-render-worker --offline && npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- build --bundles app'
scripts.worker:check: script/with_rust_toolchain.sh cargo check --manifest-path apps/geometry-worker/Cargo.toml --offline && script/with_rust_toolchain.sh cargo check --manifest-path apps/render-worker/Cargo.toml --offline
scripts.weapon:foundation:check: npm run contracts:check && npm run weapon:p1:check && npm run weapon:loft-v2:check && npm run weapon:multi-loop-profile-loft:check && npm run weapon:skill:check
scripts.mcp004:runtime: python3 scripts/check_mcp004_runtime.py && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/forgecad-mcp004-cargo-target script/with_rust_toolchain.sh cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --offline
scripts.mcp006:skills: python3 scripts/materialize_mcp006_bundles.py && python3 scripts/check_mcp006_skills.py && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/forgecad-mcp006-target script/with_rust_toolchain.sh cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p forgecad-runtime --lib skill_registry --offline
scripts.mvp:functional-core: npm run contracts:check && npm run mcp005:test && npm run mcp006:test && npm run mcp007:test && npm run mcp008:test && npm run mcp009:test
scripts.release:mcp001: npm run release:docs-walkthrough && npm run repository:integrity && npm run release:safety-scope && npm run release:secrets-files && npm run release:license-sbom && npm run contracts:check && npm run mcp:check && npm run worker:check && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:tauri-check && git diff --check
scripts.release:mcp002: npm run release:docs-walkthrough && npm run repository:integrity && npm run release:safety-scope && npm run release:secrets-files && npm run release:license-sbom && npm run contracts:check && npm run runtime:mcp002:layout && npm run runtime:mcp002 && npm run worker:check && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:tauri-check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.release:mcp003: npm run release:docs-walkthrough && npm run repository:integrity && npm run release:safety-scope && npm run release:secrets-files && npm run release:license-sbom && npm run contracts:check && npm run runtime:mcp002:layout && npm run mcp003:protocol && npm run mcp003:hosts && npm run runtime:mcp003 && npm run worker:check && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:tauri-check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.release:mcp004: npm run release:docs-walkthrough && npm run repository:integrity && npm run release:safety-scope && npm run release:secrets-files && npm run release:license-sbom && npm run contracts:check && npm run runtime:mcp002:layout && npm run mcp003:protocol && npm run mcp003:hosts && npm run mcp004:runtime && npm run mcp004:test && npm run worker:check && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:tauri-check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.release:mvp: npm run release:docs-walkthrough && npm run repository:integrity && npm run release:safety-scope && npm run release:secrets-files && npm run release:license-sbom && npm run mvp:functional-core && npm run desktop:typecheck && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:tauri-check && git diff --check
